core_obligations: Part (1): present the given finite module over R' by a short exact sequence from a finite free module and take the preimage of the kernel under the map from a finite free module over R, which gives M (proof lines 31721-31725).

Part (2): take a presentation of the given finitely presented module, clear the denominators in its matrix by multiplying with an element of the multiplicative subset, and build the finitely presented R-module from the resulting matrix over R (proof lines 31728-31738).
Check that the map sending the chosen generators to the given ones induces an isomorphism after localising the quotient by I (proof lines 31739-31740).
proof_roadmap: Lift a finite module by taking the preimage of a kernel (proof lines 31720-31725).
Lift a finitely presented module by clearing denominators in its presentation matrix (proof lines 31727-31741).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for an ideal I and a multiplicative subset S of a ring R, every finite module over the localised quotient lifts to a finite R-module, and every finitely presented module lifts to a finitely presented R-module, in both cases with the localised quotient by I recovering the given module (statement lines 31706-31718). The proof does not use a categorical lifting theorem: part (1) takes the preimage of a kernel under the map of finite free modules, and part (2) clears the denominators of the presentation matrix by multiplying with an element of the multiplicative subset and then reads off the lifted presentation (proof lines 31720-31741). The denominator clearing in the matrix is the step that carries part (2), and the author displays both constructions. H2.
